implementation_summary: Preserved and reconciled the represented T058 deterministic portable-workspace engine, CLI, and fail-closed tests with current canonical develop. Re-review corrected in-authority safety defects by binding Git inspection to the extracted repository, removing inherited Git control variables, disabling lazy promisor fetch, rejecting external object alternates, binding snapshot/write gates to the expected target branch, blocking main/develop publication and write qualification, and treating unknown sentinel state as ambiguous. No GitHub or ChatGPT Library integration, generalized gap solution, dependency, configuration, or Markdown change was added.

archive_safety.approach: Deterministic gzip/tar creation with fixed metadata; checksum verification before extraction; rejection of absolute, drive-qualified, traversal, backslash-traversal, duplicate, prefix-collision, link, device and other non-file/non-directory members; exact repository/receipt roots; empty destination requirement; post-extraction containment verification; standalone real .git requirement; external Git object alternates rejected.
archive_safety.candidate_displacement: Validation only accepts an empty destination and never promotes, overwrites, resets, cleans, or displaces an existing snapshot.

external_side_effects.statement: Production helper code contains no GitHub or ChatGPT Library API/tool integration and performs no network I/O, fetch, push, remote mutation, lock acquisition/deletion, merge, branch retirement, or Library deletion. Its only subprocess site invokes local Git fsck, status, rev-parse, and symbolic-ref inspection. Git is explicitly bound to the candidate .git and worktree, inherited GIT_* controls are removed, prompts/hooks/optional locks are disabled, GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1 prevents promisor lazy fetch, and external object alternates are rejected.

code_review.summary: Reviewed the reconciled implementation against T058-R1 through T058-R7, all preserved invariants, D066, the operating runbook, authorized scope, and the specified archive, fail-closed, subprocess, portability, and no-network obligations. Corrected all in-authority material safety findings and reran focused/static/full verification from a clean worktree. No upstream semantic re-entry is required.
resolved_findings: Sanitized inherited Git control variables, explicitly bound --git-dir/--work-tree, disabled lazy promisor fetch, and rejected external object alternates so snapshot inspection cannot redirect outside the candidate or perform implicit network I/O.
Bound snapshot and write-entry qualification to the expected target branch and blocked main/develop from writable-entry and publication-plan qualification.
Classified a present sentinel with an unknown non-ACTIVE state as ambiguous instead of owner-exists.

Retained caller-supplied changed_paths as the host observation defined by the existing T058-R6 interface; the helper normalizes/deduplicates paths and binds the manifest to independently inspected local HEAD/tree without claiming derivation or publication. Adding remote-tree/diff semantics for intentionally reconstructed commits would require new contract inputs and was not invented locally.
